maya: Postmortem follow-up: consolidate owners for rollout/canary hardening. Key items: auto-rollback, flag defaults, blast-radius tests, and a quick oncall runbook.

oliver: I'll take auto-rollback. Proposal: two-phase rollback—soft reroute (80% to stable) within 90s, full revert within 5m. Will add controller tests + a simulated traffic replay. ETA 9 days.

chun: I'll own flag policy changes. New rule: any flag touching routing/model selection must include risk_level and default_safe (default_safe=false). I'll add a validator in flag-registry and flag migration plan. ETA 4 days.

ci-bot: Created tickets: <https://tracker/redwood/INF-3101|INF-3101> auto-rollback (oliver), <https://tracker/redwood/INF-3102|INF-3102> flag-policy (chun), <https://tracker/redwood/INF-3103|INF-3103> blast-radius harness (sre-lina).

sre-lina: Blast-radius harness plan: small chaos runner that spikes errors and verifies rollback semantics; run in staging + canary cluster. ETA 7 days. Need permission to run on canary cluster 02. Requesting infra access.

maya: Please add measurable SLAs to tickets: detection latency goal <= 90s, soft-reroute <= 2m, full-revert <= 5m. Also include a simple runbook snippet for oncall: how to quarantine a flag, force revert, and where to find last-stable artifact.

oliver: Will add Prom rule and tests. Example alert: alert: RolloutTrip expr: increase(errors[5m])/increase(reqs[5m]) > 0.006 for: 2m labels: {severity: "critical"}. Wiring this into rollout-operator to trigger soft reroute.

chun: Flag metadata example I'll require: flag_name: rerank_v5 owners: ["chun"] risk_level: high default_safe: false rollout_strategy: staged
I'll block default_safe=true for risk_level in [high,critical] unless approved.

sre-lina: I'll include a small replay of the incident traffic for the harness. Also adding a short checklist to INF-3103 for verifying revert order and traffic split.

maya: Good. Weekly check-in Fri 09:00, 15m. Owners, please update ETAs in tickets by EOD tomorrow. If infra access blocks you, ping me. Thanks. :white_check_mark:
